title: She Put Pfizer's Logo on Her Own Report — Elizabeth Holmes at Trial

lines.say: April two thousand ten. Theranos is courting Walgreens.
Prosecutors said Elizabeth Holmes emailed Walgreens executives reports with favorable conclusions about Theranos, bearing the logos of Pfizer, GlaxoSmithKline and Schering-Plough.
She described them as three independent due diligence reports from those companies.

scene.q: three independent due diligence reports on Theranos systems
scene.cite: As quoted in the gov't sentencing memorandum

lines.say: At trial, she admitted that she put the logos on herself.

scene.kicker: AT TRIAL · PER THE NINTH CIRCUIT

lines.say: Witnesses from the drug companies testified they never validated the technology, and never authorized their logos.
Prosecutors said she kept sending the Pfizer report to investors in two thousand fourteen and two thousand fifteen. She was convicted of defrauding investors.
lines.show: Prosecutors said she kept sending the Pfizer report to investors in 2014 and 2015. She was convicted of defrauding investors.

scene.sub: Investor fraud · United States v. Holmes

lines.say: Real trials. Real evidence. The verdict.

label: SWORN
